caption:
Fly through all twelve signs. Don't blink 🎧✨

Each gate is its element's old symbol: fire △, earth ▽ with a bar, air △ with a bar, water ▽. The tone at each gate is the planet that traditionally rules that sign, over the year tone (136.10 Hz):

Aries · Mars · Taurus · Venus · Gemini · Mercury · Cancer · Moon · Leo · Sun · Virgo · Mercury · Libra · Venus · Scorpio · Mars · Sagittarius · Jupiter · Capricorn · Saturn · Aquarius · Saturn · Pisces · Jupiter

Screenshot your gate. Comment your sign and I'll send you its tone + what it needs in love 💛
